fact: The minister said the last population and housing census was conducted in 2017 and was the country's first digital census.

The Ministry of Economic Planning and Development with UNFPA launched the 2027 Population and Housing Census, with the Central Statistical Office conducting the first phase, the mapping and listing exercise (launch said to be 'yesterday' relative to the 7 Nov 2025 article).
The HIS profile (August 2019) answers 'population census within the last 10 years' with 'No (2007)', implying the last census was in 2007; the indicator is marked outdated.
The profile lists MICS5 (2014) as an available national health survey with data and reports on linked sites; release date not given, year of survey used.
The profile lists the DHS (2006-2007) as an available national health survey with data and reports on linked sites; release date not given, survey years used.
